policy.new_capability_rule: Every new kernel capability must map to one existing claim or introduce a new falsifiable claim before it is treated as research-relevant. A feature description alone is not evidence.
policy.review_policy: Reviewers must check that every claim remains falsifiable, evidence status is bounded by observed evidence, proof references resolve, and changes preserve schema compatibility or explicitly version it.

claim:accepted-executor-candidate-build.falsifier: A changed carrier, altered accepted executor, missing or mismatched dual-root identity, incomplete required graph, or unauthenticated artifact can establish readiness; or candidate helper changes require a separate manual build despite a supported accepted executor.
claim:accepted-executor-candidate-build.statement: For the supported remote source-CI carrier, plain validation admits candidate helper changes using an independently captured accepted executor, retains the full build/test graph and final controller verdict, and rejects substituted authority or custody.

claim:atomic-completion.falsifier: An unresolved dependency or unproven exclusive task can commit done through a direct mutation
claim:atomic-completion.statement: Every task done mutation enforces dependency and lease proof within its transaction

claim:bounded-integration-matrix.falsifier: A selected target or test is omitted/duplicated, compilation repeats inside shard runs, or any successful selective-test step takes 300 seconds or more.
claim:bounded-integration-matrix.statement: PR integration test execution uses one shared build and complete non-overlapping Gatling shards; every selective-test step finishes in under five minutes.

claim:bounded-preflight-latency.falsifier: A stale, missing, malformed, denied, cancelled, failed or mismatched input yields readiness; any applicable source obligation is dropped; bounded resource use is exceeded; or comparable measured collection has no material improvement.
claim:bounded-preflight-latency.statement: The collector removes repeated exact-request reads and overlaps bounded independent metadata retrieval, while preserving all exact-source and terminal custody checks; CI optimizations reduce measured critical-path overhead without skipping applicable execution.

claim:build-layout-compatibility:questio.decision_impact: Determines whether the root lockfile remains an intentional exception to the canonical build configuration directory.
claim:build-layout-compatibility:questio.question: Should a future Bazel release permit the generated module lockfile to move under .config/build, or must it remain root-discovered?

claim:claim:container-work-preservation.falsifier: A failed or interrupted command, local-only history, dirty tracked or untracked work, or unreadable Git status is deleted automatically; or eligible clean successful work cannot be removed.
claim:claim:container-work-preservation.statement: Automatic container workspace deletion requires successful command completion, branch foldback, verified ownership and a clean Git worktree; failed, unsynced, dirty or unverifiable work remains available with recovery diagnostics.

claim:committed-scope-enforcement.falsifier: A clean committed forbidden edit, deletion, rename source or over-budget delta reaches provider execution or readiness
claim:committed-scope-enforcement.statement: Full readiness rejects forbidden-path and file-budget violations across complete accepted-base candidate delta on native and provider routes

claim:complete-prepush-readiness.falsifier: An empty, stale, skipped-required, mocked-code or missing-provider result authorizes publication, or CLI/RPC/publish bypasses the same boundary
claim:complete-prepush-readiness.statement: Public validate can authorize source PR publication only after all applicable actual source checks and candidate builds pass with genuine current material/provider evidence; release-only packaging is explicitly outside core source scope

claim:consumer-local-proof.falsifier: Real non-Cargo failure passes, stale contract or target passes, or strict profile can downgrade
claim:consumer-local-proof.statement: Reviewed consumer local proof executes required commands against exact candidate and target without weakening strict Decapod CI proof

claim:container-boundary-integrity.falsifier: A failed execution invokes push or PR; raw gh bypasses readiness; divergent host history is overwritten; or successful cleanup deletes hidden tracked edits or new/changed stash, side branch or tag refs.
claim:container-boundary-integrity.statement: Container completion never publishes failed or local-only runs, PR requests use the common governed publisher, branch foldback rejects non-fast-forward updates, and cleanup retains index-hidden work plus refs added or changed beyond the returned branch.

claim:created-context.falsifier: A changed, unrelated, dirty, missing-base or tampered event obtains no-change status or readiness evidence
claim:created-context.statement: Only a provider-declared ordinary first push at the verified accepted target is classified as no change; actual candidate ranges remain strict

claim:current-authority-resume.falsifier: Changed source, branch lineage, intent, plan, required approval, task revision or lease owner can pass resume; or committing only checkpoint bookkeeping invalidates unchanged continuation.
claim:current-authority-resume.statement: Execution continuation checks the checkpoint against current material, accepted intent, plan, scope, policy approvals and task custody; a valid checkpoint hash alone does not grant continuation or publication readiness.

claim:current-obligation-evidence.falsifier: A required regression accepts stale cached proof, cached dependency completion, malformed requirements, dangling edges or cycles, or an unmet verify/graph command exits zero.
claim:current-obligation-evidence.statement: Obligation readiness derives from current transitive dependencies and authoritative HealthEngine evidence, not advisory caches; corrupt graphs and unmet CLI verification fail closed.

claim:current-task-proof.falsifier: A stale or unbound pass completes a work claim, unlocks dependency admission, bypasses aggregate verification, or stale verifier overwrites newer evidence
claim:current-task-proof.statement: Persisted task pass cannot authorize a different task revision, and stale verification cannot overwrite a changed baseline

claim:durable-artifact-publication.falsifier: Parent sync failure reports success, recovery follows a substituted parent symlink, a partial history is returned as complete, or admitted append crosses its recovery size bound.
claim:durable-artifact-publication.statement: Unix atomic artifact publication requires file and containing-directory synchronization; an error after rename reports unconfirmed durability without claiming rollback, and bounded journal admission cannot append an unreadable head.

claim:fresh-provider-metadata-batching.falsifier: An invalid or denied batch falls back to another route, a metadata response is reused across invocations, changed source/provider identity passes, or batching exceeds the existing concurrency/deadline bound.
claim:fresh-provider-metadata-batching.statement: Independent current provider metadata reads use bounded authorized batches; all identity, cancellation, output-bound and final freshness checks remain mandatory.

claim:full-proof-preserved.falsifier: Any missing, failed, stale, mismatched or skipped required proof can produce readiness, or an original check command is omitted
claim:full-proof-preserved.statement: All currently applicable source checks, per-check receipts, exact-source bindings and final freshness remain required under bounded transport and same-checkout grouping

claim:governed-context:question:task-cla.decision_impact: Determines routing policy and whether context selection should optimize for class-specific outcomes.
claim:governed-context:question:task-cla.question: Which task classes benefit most from narrowing, and when is additional context worth its cost?

claim:independent-entrypoint-history.falsifier: Tamper then restore to canonical HEAD can pass the full native or Buildkite readiness boundary
claim:independent-entrypoint-history.statement: Complete validation rejects unauthorized entrypoint rewrites in candidate history independently of provider-local Git gate skips

claim:intent-durability:question:sample-.decision_impact: Determines benchmark power and whether the claim can move beyond instrumented status.
claim:intent-durability:question:sample-.question: How many tasks and agent/tool combinations are needed to separate custody effects from model variance?

claim:measured-latency-reduction.falsifier: Completed comparable successful runs do not show material reduction, or queue and overlapping timings are misrepresented
claim:measured-latency-reduction.statement: The revised collector and grouped runtime lane materially reduce comparable successful preflight costs; no five-minute claim without measurement

claim:multi-agent-custody:question:share.decision_impact: Determines whether shared-interface workflows need an additional claim, protocol, or merge proof.
claim:multi-agent-custody:question:share.question: How does custody scale when tasks intentionally share an interface or require coordinated changes across workspaces?

claim:native-discovery-deadline.falsifier: A near-expired real Rust slow probe obtains a fresh discovery budget or launches after expiry.
claim:native-discovery-deadline.statement: Supplemental Rust discovery shares the original absolute validation deadline.

claim:native-release-owner.falsifier: The extracted owner script emits true for the sanitized importer, missing/unknown runner identity or explicit Buildkite markers, or false for the configured native hosted identity.
claim:native-release-owner.statement: Only the configured native GitHub-hosted owner identity selects release mutation; sanitized Buildkite imports and missing or unknown runner identity remain false before credential-bearing jobs.

claim:project-spec-purpose.falsifier: A non-Decapod fixture acquires a Decapod or provider identity, a narrow task replaces product purpose, or supported refresh rewrites authored material.
claim:project-spec-purpose.statement: Generic specs scaffolding and context extraction preserve the configured whole-project purpose across narrow task work; all Decapod specs describe the full product.

claim:proof-backed-completion:question:p.decision_impact: Determines future validation policy and whether additional proof gates are warranted.
claim:proof-backed-completion:question:p.question: Which proof gates best predict production-relevant correctness, and how should warning-heavy but passing runs be classified?

claim:proof-before-done.falsifier: Missing or failing proof leaves task done or success event committed
claim:proof-before-done.statement: Validated completion and captured successful proof commit atomically

claim:proof-recovery-no-deadlock:questio.decision_impact: Determines whether recovery can be automatic for legacy backlogs or must return tasks to an actionable open state.
claim:proof-recovery-no-deadlock:questio.question: When a task was completed by an agent whose proof record is missing, what minimum repository-native evidence is sufficient for a later agent to recover verification without recreating the original execution context?

claim:quinn-importer-compatibility.falsifier: Any old mixed unknown or changed importer identity validates, or full proof accepts malformed source/structural evidence
proof_refs: Targeted Rust importer identity tests and full decapod validate required
claim:quinn-importer-compatibility.statement: Current Buildkite importer0.102.5 is accepted only through independently reviewed version and executable digests; old mixed and unknown tuples remain rejected

claim:regular-release-artifact.falsifier: The staged upload path is a symlink or differs in bytes from the compiled Bazel output.
claim:regular-release-artifact.statement: The release-build uploader consumes an owned regular file containing exactly the successfully built Bazel binary.

claim:release-cpus.falsifier: CPU quota/affinity is exceeded, matrix targets drift, or publication gates are broadened
claim:release-cpus.statement: Release artifact compilation uses runner-effective CPU parallelism without altering global defaults, target matrix or publication gates

claim:release-ownership.falsifier: Non-owner release changes task assignment, owners or events
claim:release-ownership.statement: A different local actor cannot release current exclusive custody

claim:release-pr-provider-parity.falsifier: An imported Buildkite job retrieves release secrets or executes a release mutation, a native release path loses its owner gate, or PR-only dispatch invokes package publishing.
claim:release-pr-provider-parity.statement: Native GitHub Actions is the sole release mutation owner; Buildkite imports skip credential-bearing release jobs and do not count as publication proof. Explicit PR-only dispatch preserves normal native push behavior.

claim:release-version-stable-bazel.falsifier: A version-only candidate fails stale-lock setup, or changed dependencies build without a reviewed lock refresh
claim:release-version-stable-bazel.statement: A version-only release with unchanged dependency resolution can build through strict Bazel setup while dependency drift remains fail-closed

claim:renewed-plan-acceptance.falsifier: A changed intent, scope, proof or phase contract retains accepted state or phase completion, or phase progression promotes an unapproved plan
claim:renewed-plan-acceptance.statement: Material plan or phase contract changes revoke previous accepted state and progress before execution can continue; no-op changes preserve state

claim:repeatable-bootstrap.falsifier: Forced init resets tracker or reviewed contract, or generated workflow lacks immutable context
claim:repeatable-bootstrap.statement: Both init entrypoints preserve omitted authored config choices; generated CI includes immutable range and full history

claim:reviewed-importer-01027.falsifier: An observed green result or arbitrary version/digest tuple authorizes import; any required proof/profile/custody check is removed; or the selected controller artifact lacks verified accepted-executor and source provenance.
claim:reviewed-importer-01027.statement: The importer accepts only independently reviewed official0.102.7 compiler/Linux/Darwin executable identities, with unchanged source, producer, recipe and artifact custody checks; older, unknown, mixed and swapped tuples remain invalid.

claim:strict-protocol-rollout.falsifier: The fallback accepts altered or new carrier content after only changing the review digest, supported R failure falls back to H, or an old released executable is claimed to acquire unimplemented bootstrap behavior.
claim:strict-protocol-rollout.statement: Initial protocol rollout preserves strict independently pinned single-root compatibility, and unsupported workflow or execution contracts remain actionable blockers rather than self-authorizing a candidate controller.

claim:task-journal-reconstruction.falsifier: A supported mutation loses journal custody, replay changes verification bytes or revision, a contradictory chain is accepted, or recovery overwrites an unrelated current projection.
claim:task-journal-reconstruction.statement: Modern local task mutation and exact revision, lease, owner, dependency and proof projection checkpoints commit together in the canonical event store; recovery preserves incomplete legacy history and rejects divergent live authority.

claim:trajectory-journal-recoverability.falsifier: Changing run ID discards uncommitted failures, assumptions, blockers or Jev evidence without Git recovery
claim:trajectory-journal-recoverability.statement: Starting a different trajectory cannot replace an uncommitted governance journal through supported APIs

claim:validation-without-operator-receip.falsifier: The first checked validation push needs an operator receipt; a changed command/root/head/ref/repository inherits the seal; or unrelated write/provider restrictions are bypassed.

No result grants merge or release authority.

claim:vega-current-run-scientific-collec.falsifier: Missing/replayed/mixed/unsafe/malformed phases, altered frozen inputs/labels, inconsistent decisions, numerical disagreement, failed adverse controls, absent positive coverage, hidden oracle mismatches or an abstaining verdict permit publication readiness.

claim:vega-native-acceptance.falsifier: Publication occurs without complete current source/native/numerical/functional proof, without positive approval on both backends, with unsafe adverse outcomes, or by presenting agent-authored functional labels as independently calibrated domain accuracy.

Maintainer-authorized qualification supersedes the prior research prerequisite without passing it; all old failures and domain-accuracy limits remain preserved.

claim:vega-positive-singleton.falsifier: A disabled or repinned accepted required policy, failed/stale check, adverse projection omission, changed binding, negative/ambiguous/OOD/abstaining result can establish readiness.

Complete deterministic proof precedes inference. Fixed functional observations come from executed bounded candidate checks but unsigned replay never grants custody or publication. Exposed v2 and zero-unit research admission stay historical, not passing accuracy or current research prerequisites.

Review verdicts/rationale, future CI, conflicting identities and incomplete source histories cannot become independent readiness truth. Maintainer-authorized functional qualification does not claim that the old study or risk criterion passed.

claim:vega1445-readiness-role-qualificat.falsifier: Qualification passes an always-abstaining/rejecting model, lacks approval on either backend, accepts unmet obligations/manipulation, accepts malformed inference, hides an oracle mismatch, changes model/input/threshold/tolerances, or grants readiness to failed/stale/abstaining work.

A ready control may validly abstain, preserving its frozen expected-accept mismatch and blocking that assessed work. Domain accuracy and old research success remain unestablished.
